newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: F.E. Levingston acquires rig design rights.
newsitem.headline: F.E. Levingston acquires rig design rights.

text.p: Far East Levingston said on Tuesday it had obtained exclusive rights for the design of harsh environmental jack-up rigs from design engineering company Friede & Goldman Ltd (F&G).
It said in a statement this followed the recent purchase of all intellectual property rights in the design and trademarks by FELS from F&G.

FELS and a U.S.-based subsidiary, AMFELS Inc, will now be able to offer the MOD V and MOD VI designs, used for the construction of rigs such as the Monarch, Monitor, Magellan and jack-up Galaxy 1, to their customers.
